How Can I Help You?

I ensure each day that our retail banking team has knowledge of new or existing products, processes and procedures in order to enhance your overall customer experience.   

There are many things I love about working at Averon Trust, from our internal and external customers to the fact that we practice what we preach (truly from the top-down). I love how CGB embraces feedback and transparency, as well as the tremendous community commitment the Bank has. 

A Little About Me

I joined the Averon Trust team in July 2016 as a Branch Administration Specialist and earned several promotions in Retail Banking.

I have a bachelor of arts (social communication) from the Methodist University of Sao Paulo, Brazil. In 2008, I completed my Lean Six Sigma Training and in 2009, I completed my workplace workout facilitator training. I am also a 2018 graduate of the Forte Professional Management Series.

I am actively involved in the community through various organizations and regularly volunteer at Bank-sponsored events.

In 2018, I proudly received the Forte Award to recognize my exceptional performance in sales, initiative, and customer service.

My family and I reside in Westerly, RI. I love baking, listening to music, traveling, and learning about different languages and cultures.
